sources.title: Residential Building Worker Wage Growth Rebounds, but Real Wages Continue to Decline
sources.description: In nominal terms, average hourly earnings (AHE) for residential building workers increased 2.8% year-over-year in September 2026, reaching $40.69 per hour. This marked an acceleration from the 1.2% year-over-year increase recorded in June 2026. After accounting for inflation, real wages declined 0.9% year-over-year in September 2026 to $12.1 per hour.

sources.title: NAR membership proves more resilient than expected, topping 1.46 million
sources.description: In an update at NAR’s 2026 NXT Board of Directors meeting by NAR’s 2026 Treasurer Craig Sanford, it was revealed that at the end of September, the association had 1,469,127 members, 22% better than the 1.2 million members the association had budgeted for and just 1.5% lower than membership a year ago. In addition, Sanford said membership renewals for 2027 are tracking in line with where they were in 2026.
